description: This file defines error interpretation functions for various storage operation errors in the Kubernetes API server, converting storage errors into appropriate API errors.

methods.name: InterpretListError
methods.description: Converts a generic error on a list retrieval into an API error.

methods.name: InterpretGetError
methods.description: Converts a generic error on a get operation into an API error.

methods.name: InterpretCreateError
methods.description: Converts a generic error on a create operation into an API error.

methods.name: InterpretUpdateError
methods.description: Converts a generic error on an update operation into an API error.

methods.name: InterpretDeleteError
methods.description: Converts a generic error on a delete operation into an API error.

methods.name: InterpretWatchError
methods.description: Converts a generic error on a watch operation into an API error.
